item.title: At First Glance, The Los Angeles Kings Hit A Home Run With The Artemi Panarin Trade
item.description: The Los Angeles Kings pulled off a blockbuster trade with the acquisition of New York Rangers star left winger Artemi Panarin. And the price the Kings paid to bring in Panarin is a low-risk, high-reward move.

item.title: NHL Draft Prospect Gavin McKenna Faces Four Charges In Pennsylvania
item.description: Gavin McKenna faces a felony charge of aggravated assault and three other counts after a reported and alleged altercation.

item.title: 'It Was A Brutal Hit': Bruins Coach And Fans React To Charlie McAvoy Taking A Flying Elbow To The Head
item.description: In Florida's 5-4 shootout win against Boston on Wednesday, Panthers' forward Sandis Vilmanis caught Bruins defenseman Charlie McAvoy with a leaping elbow to the head that temporarily knocked McAvoy out of the game

item.title: NHL Rumor Roundup: The Biggest Trade Candidates Entering The Olympic Break
item.description: The New York Rangers' shipping of Artemi Panarin to the Los Angeles Kings removed the biggest name in the NHL trade market, but several quality players remain as trade candidates.

item.title: On The Ice, Artemi Panarin Is An All-Time New York Rangers Great
item.description: In the 100 years of the New York Rangers, Artemi Panarin isn't in the very top tier, but he's right below that.

item.title: Olympic Hockey Poll: Predicting The Podiums, Top Players, Flops And More
item.description: The 2026 Winter Olympics have arrived. THN.com's team of editors and writers voted on a slew of intriguing questions in advance of the Games. Who will gold? Who gets MVP honors?

item.title: The Wraparound: How Well Does Artemi Panarin Fit On The Kings?
item.description: Emma Lingan, Michael Augello and Jim Parsons discuss the Panarin and Bjugstad trades, Jake Sanderson's month, Robert Thomas, the Jets and much more

item.title: Hurricanes' Seth Jarvis Replaces Brayden Point On Canada's Olympic Team
item.description: Seth Jarvis, who played at the 4 Nations Face-Off, will play on Team Canada instead of Brayden Point, who was ruled out of the Olympics with an injury.

item.title: NHL Hot Seat Radar: Flyers' Rick Tocchet Must Rebound From This Week
item.description: Flyers coach Rick Tocchet, Utah Mammoth bench boss Andre Tourigny and New Jersey Devils star Jack Hughes face pressure this week.

item.title: Olympic Women's Hockey: Canada Face A Disadvantage After Postponed Game
item.description: Canada and Finland's first game of the Olympics was postponed due to a norovirus outbreak affecting the Finns. The time of their rescheduled game could seriously affect Canada's chances of winning gold.
